description.zh: 本課程旨在提昇學生的人文素養。透過文學概論、藝術概論與文化概論等相關課程，引導學生探索文學的妙趣，欣賞藝術的美質，瞭解文化的傳統。從古典到現代，從本土到世界，從物質到心靈，建構多元化的文化視野。以臺灣為出發點，搜尋未知的世界地圖，找到人們必然駐足的角落，以及自己不可缺席的人文風景。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to enrich the literary taste and the cultural cultivation of our students. Though the related course, like Introduction of Literature, Introduction of Art and Introduction of Culture, we hope to guide the students to explore the interest of the Literature, to enjoy the beauty of the Art and to understand the tradition of the Culture. From classic to modern, from local to universe, from material to spirit, we want to construct multiple cultural views. Taking Taiwan as a start, we would search the unknown map of the universe, and would find a corner for consequential staying and one's own liberal scenery.

name.zh: 博雅核心課程 - 文化
name.en: Core Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：Culture

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生對歷史這門學科有一通盤、系統的認識，以便讓學生瞭解歷史的思維取向，增加個人的歷史意識。並在歷史學門的領域中，提供數門基礎及進階課程，供同學選修，以期同學從課程的學習中，理解台灣、中國乃至世界文明的進程與發展，剖析歷史學與現實的互動，提昇學生批判思考之能力。
description.en: This course focuses on getting the students familiar with the academic field of history in a more comprehensive and systematic view. The students are stimulated to think and make judgment with a view to "knowing the history," adding to a better sense of history. Further, they are guided to select some courses in the field of history, including the formation and changes of the of Taiwan China and the World-as well as interactions between history and the reality-thus enhancing their critical ability to think and judge.

name.zh: 博雅核心課程 - 歷史
name.en: Core Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：History

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於教導學生能夠以線性代數中所提供之各種方法來求解線性連立方程組，並奠定研習線型規畫，作業研究，等課程之基礎。由於本系分兩組教學，因應之課程內容分別為：管理組：矩陣、方程式之解、行列式、向量、微分方程式及應用問題等。工程組：矩陣方程式之解、行列式、向量及向量空間等。
description.en: The objective of this course is to introduce the linear algebra by using several different methods to solve the linear dependent equations and to build up the fundamental knowledge of linear programming and Operation Research. Two groups instruct the contents of this course. For the engineering group the array, solution of combinatory equations, vectors, differential equations and its implementation are included. For the management group the array, solution of combinatory equations, vectors and vector spaces are included.

description.zh: 介紹 C++ 語言基本資料處理的概念， 包含基本輸入與輸出、程式的流程控制、函數的應用等指令之撰寫、程式之編輯、編譯、聯絡與程式之執行，並發展一套應用程式。
description.en: This course introduces the basic data processes of C++ language. They include input/output, program process control, application of functions, program editing and execution, and so on.

interdisciplinary: 管理_第二專長【工管系_產業電子化與資訊應用】

description.zh: 探討工作研究涵蓋之各項技術：時間研究、動作研究、程序分析、作業分析、影片分析、工作抽查、標準工時與效率管理、動作經濟原理、生產線平衡、生產力衡量等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide students with a resource which describes the techniques and procedures of motion and time study .It contains: techniques of methods study, work station design, PTS, stop watch time study, standard data, assembly line balancing.

interdisciplinary: 管理_第二專長【工管系_生產管理與製造服務】

description.zh: 本課程旨在使學生經由實習去熟練下列各項技術：時間研究、動作研究、程序分析、作業分析、影片分析、工作抽查、標準工時與效率管理、動作經濟原理、生產線平衡、生產力衡量等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide students with a practice about the techniques and procedures of motion and time study. It contains techniques of methods study, work station design, PTS, stop watch time Study, standard data, assembly line balancing.

interdisciplinary: 管理_第二專長【工管系_生產管理與製造服務】

description.zh: 本課程在於使同學瞭解管理思想的演進，與管理有關之重要理論，以及未來管理之發展趨勢。課程主要內容包括：組織與管理、管理哲學、管理思想的演進、管理功能（規畫、領導、組織、控制、評估）、溝通、組織成長與改變、未來之管理、個案研討。
description.en: This course will cover the progress of management, the theories of management and the future of management. It consists of 1. Organization and management. 2. Philosophies of management. 3. The function of management. 4. Communication. 5. The future of management. 6. Case studies.

description.zh: 零售業包含百貨業、連鎖店、超市、超商等，與人們的關係極切・本課程主在探討如何經由零賣出使顧客滿意的商品・內容：零售業概論、配銷通路、行銷研究、產品管理策略、定價策略、促銷策略、賣場規劃、零售業經營策略、顧客滿意
description.en: Retail management is mainly to discuss to sell goods through channels and satisfy them. The content of the course: Retail concept, physical distribution, market research, product management strategy, pricing strategy, promotion strategy, retail strategy and customer satisfaction.

In the first semester, the course covers important articles in literature, in the hope for the student learners to cultivate better ability to taste literary works when they have more vivid sense on the language. With fuller knowledge on what literature is about, they are expected to try creative writings. For the second semester, the course is mainly focused on the writings on thoughts. It is our expectation that throughout the reading and analysis of various great schools of philosophy, the student learners are given the opportunity to explore the huge minds of philosophers, who will thus be imitated and followed. Through the internalization, the students might benefit themse

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 講述知識性內容包括瞭解設計的意義、造形原理、立體構成、材料質感等知識，並演練繪圖、材料、加工等立體設計技能。以及各種幫助人類生活的各種設計領域並討論思想性內容，包括啟發思考及評判的態度以培養正確之設計觀。
description.en: Talking about the beginning of design, observe commodities on the surrounding market places, and find how companies provide their commodities for the consumers "wisely" to attract buyers. Discussion and practice on creativity. Introduce product development techniques, product design processes and how to evaluate good products for human beings.Students explore product aesthetics and basic formal issues as they pertain to industrial design. This course integrates the principles of three dimensional design, drawing and prototyping as they apply to the generation of product form. Emphasis is placed on issues that dictate the form of products and their creation. Students develop basic prototyping, conceptual drawing, and presentation skills for the purpose of exploring, analyzing, refining and communicating design concepts.

description.zh: 介紹家具設計工作的範圍與理念。藉由個案探討及理論解說使學生熟 練設計專案的邏輯、資料收集、問卷調查、使用者研究、產品規範、 構想展開與評估等技術。
description.en: This course contains a collection of fifteen design methods that students might find useful at various stages of a design projects. Students will have to pick and choose among them to construct their own design process using their own imagination and preferred ways of working, as well as the methods themselves. No matter what the types of prospect in mind, student should be able to find at least one or two methods to help them to get started, to change direction or furnish.

description.zh: 本課程講授家具工程製圖技術及相關知識，著重在家具工程製圖與一般工程製圖的主要差別，其能讓學生將所設計的家具產品以圖面表達其細部結構與工程要件。
description.en: This is the lecture of furniture engineering drawing technique and related knowledge, It emphases on the main difference between furniture engineering drawing and normal engineering drawing. The aim is for students to present the detailed construction and main parts of their furniture design product by drawing.

description.zh: 應用試作技術課程之試作技術，進行家具相關設計圖面實體模型之材料加工、組裝實作。
description.en: To practice product model making techniques. Based on furniture product working drawing, design students can practice model making techniques with different materials and processing methods.

description.zh: 本課程以越南語教學為主，培養學生的聽、說、讀、寫能力，以達到溝通的目的，增進學生對越南文化的認識與興趣，提供學生越南語的基礎知識，越南經貿、觀光文化及越語字母拼音教學，讓學生在學習越語的同時，深入了解越南文化，協助學生拓展東南亞的就業版圖。
description.en: This course will help students have basic communicate skill, basic knowledge of Vietnamese (including alphabet, phonetic and grammar) and better understand Vietnam culture.

description.zh: 練習設計構想草圖速繪法；從基本幾何形體至複雜產品、空間循序漸進；常用材質（木質、金屬、透明材質、石材及皮革等）之表現技法；產品精描、透視圖法、三視圖、爆炸圖、組立圖等之精描，說明圖板及各種畫材（麥克筆、粉彩、色鉛筆及水彩）等之應用。
description.en: This course put emphasis on offering students having enough skills on :1.Abilities to sketch their idea visible to the others.2.Coloring design sketches to let the drawings have better comprehensibility.3.Good skill for Renderings. Medias for this course shall include markers, pastels water colors and color pencils.

description.zh: 解說大型相機多重焦距調整和影像形狀的修正及變形功能, 如何配合造型設計及啟發造形創意, 使學生熟悉大型相機操作方式及攝影技巧, 由忠實表現學生自己設計成品的表面材質感. 形狀. 體積. 色彩等等, 再深入到表現. 特色. 機能. 價值感等發揮實用攝影行銷及展示的功效.
description.en: Through the detailed explanations of multiple focusing adjustments and image correcting methods of the view camera (large format camera) to help students master the operation of the camera and many other photo taking techniques. The students shall be able to take picture of their own designing product (showing the right material quality, surface texture, the form, volume, weight and color).Furthermore, the students are requested to learn, to make full use of their knowledge as to show the character, function, value and uniqueness of their product in the picture for the purpose marketing promotion and exhibition.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1) 藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2) 使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3) 熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4) 透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

notes: 初級 / 中彰投分署 (台中) 上課

Through the internalization, the students might benefit themse

notes: 中彰投分署 (台中) 上課

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

notes: 中彰投分署 (台中) 上課

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters, and 3 lecture hours per week.

notes: 中彰投分署 (台中) 上課

description.zh: 實習操作車身矯正設備，肇事大、小變形車修理，車身校正，車身板件部份切換，以及封縫膠及防處理。
description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Using body working equipment, Collision repair, Body alignment, Body panel replacement and sectioning, and Sealer, adhesive, and anti-rust treatment.

name.zh: 汽車板金及塗裝實習 (四)
name.en: Auto Body Repair and Refinishing Workshop (IV)

description.zh: 先修課程：無。本實習內容為汽車傳動系統及車身鈑噴實習，包含汽車車身及機車車架拆裝調整檢修，傳動系統元件拆裝調整檢修，車身測量，車身研磨、焊接及液壓施力設備之操作，金屬鈑金件之維修，車架及車身之校正及調整，門緣、車頭、玻璃及防潮條之更換，碰撞損壞之維修；塗裝及噴漆設備，塗裝及噴漆材料，配色技巧，車輛之塗裝及噴漆實際操作，完成品之品質檢驗。95 學年度前入學者適用下列實習內容: 車輛電系和可程式控制器，包括：引擎電系，充電系檢測，點火系檢測，電池之檢測與換裝，電腦控制系檢測，電腦診斷系統檢測，其他電控系統檢測；可程式控制器系統規劃，可程式控制器之整合與評估，可程式控制器應用。
description.en: Automobile Drive Trains , Body Refinishing and Painting Service Shop Practice , Include the Repair, Overhaul and Trouble-Shooting of Automobile Transmission and Chassis, Automobile Body and Motorcycle Frame Assembly, Basic Dimensional Measurements, Inspection and Adjustments. The practice of automobile body sanding, welding and hydraulic straightening equipment; repairing of the sheet-metal panels; frame and body alignment; door trim, headlinings, glass and weatherstripping replacement; repairing of the collision damages ; Automobile refinishing and painting equipment, refinishing and painting materials , color matching, the practice of refinishing and painting of the vehicle , painting quality testing .For those students who enter the school before 2006 Fall Semester , the practice contents are :Electrical and Electronic System, Battery, Starting System, Charging System, Ignition System, Computer Control System, Computer Diagnostic System. Programmable logic controller (PLC) combi

description.zh: 柴油引擎 - 四行程柴油引擎、燃燒與燃燒室、燃料系統、預熱起動系統、電腦控制燃油噴射系統，汽車空調 - 冷氣基本作用原理、相關基礎熱力學、冷媒及冷凍油、汽車冷氣系統構造、汽車冷氣電路、汽車自動空調系統，汽車專業英文。
description.en: Diesel Engines include Four-Stroke Diesel engine, Combustion and combustion chamber, Fuel systems, Pre-Heat starting systems and Computer control fuel injection systems; Auto Air Condition Systems include Fundamental theory, Basic thermodynamics, Refrigerant and refrigerant oil, Construction, Electrical circuits and automatic air condition systems; Basic English for automotive service .

description.zh: 課程包含識圖與製圖，電腦輔助製圖，量具、畫線、切斷，彎曲，車身板金接縫與邊緣，車身材料，塗料組成、溶劑、稀釋液，塗料樹脂種類與乾燥、硬化原理，塗裝研磨材料，塗裝遮蔽用材料，拋光用研磨膏及保護臘，以及汽車塗裝美容用材料之介紹。
description.en: The course includes the following topics: Learning to read and make design drawings, Computer-aided drafting, Measurement systems, line drawing, and cutting, Bending, Body sheet metal seaming and hemming, Body materials, Paints, solvents, and thinners, Paint resin and curing, Paint abrasives, Masking materials, Polishing paste and protection wax, and Vehicle cosmetic materials.

name.en: Auto Body Repair and Refinishing Technology (II)

description.zh: 汽車材料的構成，金屬、非金屬、非鐵金屬、燒結合金及複合材料等在汽車分野上的應用，汽車材料的動向。
description.en: Compositions of Automotive Material，Applications of Metal、Nonmetal、Nonferrous Metal、Sintered Alloy、Composite materials for Automotive、Automotive Materia

description.zh: 底盤系統定期保養，輪胎平衡，四輪定位，變速箱分解檢查及故障排除。汽油及柴油引擎拆裝，引擎量測與調整，引擎啟動、點火、燃油、冷卻及潤滑系統之定期保養檢測及故障排除。
description.en: Experiments on vehicle chassis, and transmission. Inspection, adjustment and repair of chassis system, tire balance, wheel alignment, overhaul and trouble-shooting of transmission. Gasoline & diesel engine assembly, engine test, engine tune-up and repair, trouble-shooting and instrument adjustment on: ignition system, fuel system, cooling system, lubrication system, and starting system.

description.zh: 車身研磨、焊接及液壓施力設備之操作，金屬鈑金件之維修，車架及車身之校正及調整，門緣、車頭、玻璃及防潮條之更換，碰撞損壞之維修；塗裝及噴漆設備，塗裝及噴漆材料，配色技巧，車輛之塗裝及噴漆實際操作，完成品之品質檢驗。
description.en: The practice of automobile body sanding, welding and hydraulic straightening equipment; repairing of the sheet-metal panels; frame and body alignment; door trim, headlinings, glass and weatherstripping replacement; repairing of the collision damages ; Automobile refinishing and painting equipment, refinishing and painting materials , color matching, the practice of refinishing and painting of the vehicle , painting quality testing .

description.zh: 實習素色調色 (色相、明度、彩度)，珍珠銀粉色調色，三層珍珠色調色，小美容、以及全車大美容。
description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Plain paint blending (including hue, lightness, and saturation), Pearl silver-color blending, Pearl color paint mixing, Vehicle salon, and Full vehicle spa.

name.zh: 汽車板金及塗裝實習 (五)
name.en: Auto Body Repair and Refinishing Workshop (V)

description.zh: 實習車身定位，車門、窗組件綜合檢修，汽車車體綜合檢修，以及汽車生產製造過程或維修服務實務參觀見學。
description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Vehicle body positioning, Doors and windows comprehensive check and repair, Full vehicle body overhaul, and Tours to learn vehicle manufacturing process and service.

name.zh: 汽車板金及塗裝實習 (六)
name.en: Auto Body Repair and Refinishing Workshop (VI)

description.zh: 課程重點：(1) 藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2) 使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3) 熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4) 透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters, and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 窗型空調、箱型空調、中央空調、除濕空調、及各型空調實習、運輸空調實習、各種空調過程實驗及空氣性質點之測定、空調熱回收裝置。
description.en: To familiarize students with practice of room air conditioner, package air conditioner, central air conditioning system, dehumidifying air conditioning system, etc. To provide students with abilities of experiment of air conditioning processes and measurement of air properties.

interdisciplinary: 機電_第二專長【能源冷凍空調系_冷凍空調】

description.zh: 各種壓縮機起動控制、順序控制、溫度控制、濕度控制、水流量控制、外氣控制、焓值控制、氣壓控制、電動控制、電子控制等實習。
description.en: To familiarize students with practice of compressor control, sequence control, temperature control, humidity control, flow control, outdoor air control, enthalpy control, and pneumatic control, electric control, electronic control on HVAC systems.

interdisciplinary: 機電_第二專長【能源冷凍空調系_能源】

description.zh: 本課程實習內容主要包含冷凍空調節能技術；動態節能模擬分析；無塵室節能技術；潔淨能源 (諸如太陽能、風能、燃料電池等) 技術。
description.en: This practice course mainly contains: energy-saving technology in refrigeration and air conditioning, dynamic energy simulation, energy-saving technology in cleanrooms and clean energy (such as solar energy, wind energy, and fuel cell, etc).

interdisciplinary: 機電_第二專長【能源冷凍空調系_能源】

description.zh: 以套裝軟體學習電腦輔助繪圖，及如何將此技術應用於冷凍空調領域。
description.en: Computer Aided Drawing For HVAC & R Engineering by using package software.

description.zh: 本課程講授工業電子相關之原理，包含: 1. 基本元件簡介、2. 電晶體開關裝置及其應用、 3. 電子元件及其應用、 4. SCR 與 TRIAC、 5. 感測器原理與應用。本課程並包含下列實習單元: R - L-C 元件, 諧振電路, 濾波電路與變壓器, 零件運用與電路檢修, 感測器應用。
description.en: This course provides design-oriented approach to the understanding of electronic devices, circuits, and system used in industry. Both lectures and laboratory exercises are provided.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電磁之基本原理及定律，並講解各種電機、變壓器之特性、理論、及控制方法，透過實習課程使同學明瞭機器驅動所用之動力其電功與機械功之轉換原理與控制進而可自行操作及維護。
description.en: An introduction of the basic principles of the electro-magnetic theories. Topics include the characteristics, theories and control algorithms of the various electrical equipment and transformers.

description.zh: 商用冷凍系統電路元件介紹、商用冷凍冷藏設備電路裝配、冷媒管路系統裝配、故障判斷及排除。
description.en: Introduction of electric circuits of commercial refrigeration systems, electric circuit of commercial refrigeration facilities, installation of refrigerant piping system and trouble shooting.

description.zh: 箱型空調機電路裝配、冷卻水管路施工安裝、冷媒管路系統裝配、故障判斷及排除、冷媒更換。恆溫恆濕空調系統控制電路配線、中央空調系統試陣調整、水量與風量平衡調整、TAB 操作。
description.en: Electric circuit of air handler, installation of coolant piping, installation of coolant pipe system, trouble shooting, refrigerant replacement, constant electric circuit of air-conditioner control for constant temperature and humidity, test and balance of central units, test and balance of water and air flow.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一年級實施普通班體育正課教學。四技二、三年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一年級實施普通班體育正課教學。四技二、三年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman Sophomore and Junior students while it is an elective for senior students. For Freshman level, Classes focus on basic physical strength training. For Sophomore and Junior students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1) 藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2) 使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3) 熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4) 透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh: 國文，是運用本國語言文字，蘊釀於欣賞文藝作品，充實文化內涵，增進思維能力與人文素養的一門課程。本課程分為大一上學期 2 學分，大一下學期 2 學分。大一上學期的授課內容，以文學名篇為範圍；希望藉此擴建學生深入品味文學趣味的能力，鍛鍊靈活的語文敏感度，默契文學創意，甚而嘗試創作。大一下學期的授課內容，以思想名篇為範圍；希望藉此啟發學生透轍分析各家學說思想，漫步哲人的宇宙天地，跟隨哲人的心路歷程，進而念茲在茲，從容內化，共饗取之不盡用之不竭的先驗與風範。
description.en: "Chinese" is the course where we make full use of our native languages to enjoy literary works, to enrich our cultural taste, to develop our thinking and even to elevate human cultivation.This four-credit course is set for the freshman students: with 2 credits in each of the two semesters of the school year. In the first semester, the course covers important articles in literature, in the hope for the student learners to cultivate better ability to taste literary works when they have more vivid sense on the language. With fuller knowledge on what literature is about, they are expected to try creative writings. For the second semester, the course is mainly focused on the writings on thoughts. It is our expectation that throughout the reading and analysis of various great schools of philosophy, the student learners are given the opportunity to explore the huge minds of philosophers, who will thus be imitated and followed. Through the internalization, the students might benefit themse

description.zh: 本課程旨在提昇學生的人文素養。透過文學概論、藝術概論與文化概論等相關課程，引導學生探索文學的妙趣，欣賞藝術的美質，瞭解文化的傳統。從古典到現代，從本土到世界，從物質到心靈，建構多元化的文化視野。以臺灣為出發點，搜尋未知的世界地圖，找到人們必然駐足的角落，以及自己不可缺席的人文風景。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to enrich the literary taste and the cultural cultivation of our students. Though the related course, like Introduction of Literature, Introduction of Art and Introduction of Culture, we hope to guide the students to explore the interest of the Literature, to enjoy the beauty of the Art and to understand the tradition of the Culture. From classic to modern, from local to universe, from material to spirit, we want to construct multiple cultural views. Taking Taiwan as a start, we would search the unknown map of the universe, and would find a corner for consequential staying and one's own liberal scenery.

name.zh: 博雅核心課程 - 文化
name.en: Core Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：Culture

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生對歷史這門學科有一通盤、系統的認識，以便讓學生瞭解歷史的思維取向，增加個人的歷史意識。並在歷史學門的領域中，提供數門基礎及進階課程，供同學選修，以期同學從課程的學習中，理解台灣、中國乃至世界文明的進程與發展，剖析歷史學與現實的互動，提昇學生批判思考之能力。
description.en: This course focuses on getting the students familiar with the academic field of history in a more comprehensive and systematic view. The students are stimulated to think and make judgment with a view to "knowing the history," adding to a better sense of history. Further, they are guided to select some courses in the field of history, including the formation and changes of the of Taiwan China and the World-as well as interactions between history and the reality-thus enhancing their critical ability to think and judge.

name.zh: 博雅核心課程 - 歷史
name.en: Core Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：History

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 介紹程式語言設計的基本概念，包含基本輸入與輸出、程式的流程控制、函數的應用等指令之撰寫、程式之編輯、編譯、聯絡與程式之執行，並發展一套應用程式。並加強實務程式製作。
description.en: This course introduces the basic data processes of C++ language. They include input/output, program process control, application of functions, program editing and execution, and so on.

description.zh: 本實驗課程針對已有學習程式設計經驗的學生開設。本課程的主要目標為： 1. 訓練學生有良好的 Java 程式設計能力 2. 訓練學生有能力用電腦解決問題 3. 訓練學生有能力看懂他人寫的程式
description.en: The course is designed for students with some programming experience. The course objects are: 1.Good Java programming 2.Problem solving through computer programming 3.Understand programs coded by the third party.

description.zh: 學習經濟理論的基本觀念，涵蓋個體與總體經濟學相關議題，包括市場如何運作，市場與福利，公共部門經濟學，廠商行為與產業組織，勞動市場經濟學，總體經濟學資料，長期實質經濟，長期貨幣與物價，開放體系的總體經濟學，短期經濟波動等主題。
description.en: This course provides the basic concept of economic theory, including microeconomics and macroeconomics. The topics are as follows: how markets work, markets and welfare, the economics of the public sector, firm behavior and the organization of industry, the economics of the labor market, the data of macroeconomics, the real economy in the long run, money and prices in the long run, the macroeconomics of open economics, and short-run economic fluctuations.

notes: 資財一乙與資財一甲合開

description.zh: 本課程可使學生瞭解：貨幣與資金市場、投資問題、如何取得資金與運用資金、使公司價值最大、使股東權益最大化、瞭解代理制度、瞭解公司股票、債務之利用，股利政策等事項。
description.en: This course has provided: money and capital market、Investments 、How to obtaining and using funds、Maximize the value o their firms、How to maximize stockholders' stock、To know agency problem 、To know the price of the firm's stock, use of debt and dividend policy.

description.zh: 本課程將安排在寒暑假間進行。學生組團由學院教授帶領到國外（含中國大陸）與先安排好的一所合作大學宿讀，此期間由國外合作大學派員在課堂學員們介紹該國地域性的產業型態與國家經濟政策，另安排到當地企業廠商做實地觀摩與考察。返校後由領隊教授引導主持，進行綜合討論，學生必須在返台灣後一個月內提交心得報告及建議。
description.en: This course is conducted during the summer or winter breaks. Led by the professors, students will travel to overseas (including Mainland China) and study at a pre-arranged local university. During this period, students will be briefed on the business environment and national policies of the countries they are visiting. They will then conduct the tours of local business. Upon returning, a seminar, facilitated by the professors, will be held to exchange the views and opinions. Students are required to submit a final report with recommendations within one month after their return to Taiwan.

name.zh: 海外管理實務觀摩與研習

description.zh: 本課程的主旨在研討資訊管理的發展及新趨勢，內容包含資訊策略管理、資料庫管理、網路管理、電腦硬體技術、系統分析、軟體工程、管理資訊系統、決策支援系統、商業智慧、資訊倫理、資訊安全、知識管理、社會網絡等。
description.en: The focus of this course is on research and discussion of the developments and novel trends of information management. The topics include information strategy management, database management, network management, computer hardware developments, system analysis, software engineering, management information systems, decision support systems, business intelligence, information ethics, information security, knowledge management, social networks, and so forth.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 碩士學位論文寫作
description.en: A student must write a thesis to fulfill the partial requirements for the Master degree.

description.zh: 研究生在第一年必須選定指導教授，以決定設計創作或論文寫作的方向，從事設計創作的研究生必須發展創作理念、創作過程與實作說明，最後彙整創作報告形同於研究論文；從事論文寫作的研究生針對互動媒體設計的相關主題進行研究，並將研究成果撰寫成為論文，其內容包含緒論、文獻探討、研究設計與實施、研究結果與討論、結論與建議等。本課程目的旨在培養獨立企劃研究能力，建構研究設計與研究寫作的能力，對設計創作組而言，過程中培養協同合作的能力是必須具備的要項。
description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and pr92tical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of inter92tive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and appro92hes, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

description.zh: 論文寫作。
description.en: Thesis writing.

notes: 碩二生 (105 級) 必修

description.zh: 本課程將邀請產、官、學界知名人士，以演講或座談的方式，與 EMBA 學生交流溝通及討論。利用這些知名人士的實務經驗與學養，來啟發 EMBA 學生的創意與想法。
description.en: This course will invite the renowned individuals in business, government, and universities to exchange the ideas and opinions with the EMBA students through invited speech or seminar. The idea is to utilize the practical experience and knowledge possessed by these individuals to inspire the innovation and thinking of EMBA students.

description.zh: 本課程是設計給研究所的理工科學生作為研習科技法律的入門課程，內容大體上包括有專利法簡介、商標法簡介、著作權法簡介、營業秘密法簡介、網域名稱簡介、個案討論等等。在二十一世紀知識爆炸的時代中，技術創新已然成為企業競爭力不能忽視的一環，成功的企業無不就其開發出來的技術想盡辦法佈施層層法律保護網，於是，如何分析解讀競爭對手的法律保護網，如何研發出完全相容又具競爭性的產品，是現代研發單位不能不面對的一項課題，所牽涉到的層面多與科技法律相關。
description.en: The course is designed as a preliminary technology law study for graduate school students majoring in science and engineering . It is focused on issues related to: An introduction to Patent Law, An Introduction to Trademark Law, An introduction Copyright Law, An Introduction to Trade Secret Law, An Introduction to Domain Name and Case Discussions, etc. In the 21st century characterized by the information explosion, technological innovation has been widely recognized as being a vital factor to the competitiveness of business. Successful companies have always tried their best to implement broad-reaching legal protection of their innovated technologies. Consequently, it appears to be essential for every R&D unit to know how to analyze the legal protection for the competitors' products and how to develop a fully compatible and competitive product.

description.zh: 1. 電子光學簡介 2. 穿透式電子顯微鏡之結構與成像原理 3. 電子繞射理論 4. 電子繞射圖型及缺陷分析方法 5. 掃瞄式電子顯微鏡之結構與成像原理 6. EDS 及 WDS 之 X 光光譜分析
description.en: 1.Introduction to electron optics2. Electron Beam and Their Interaction with Specimen3. Electron Diffraction4. The Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM)5. The Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM)6. Chemical Analysis in the Electron Microscope

description.zh: 本課程主要是開設給已經修過 "粉末冶金學" 的學生，對粉末冶金製程與粉末冶金技術的應用有更進一步的認識。課程的安排在製程方面，強調粉末特性對粉末冶金製程的影響，成形模具的設計，燒結理論與現象，燒結体的後處理等。應用方面以本國現有的粉末冶金工廠與其製品為主，例如：機械零件、超硬工具材料、磁性材料、電接點材料、摩擦材料等製程的講述。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Topic of powder metallurgy.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹一些廣泛、基本及實際的微電子材料（其中最主要者為積體電路之材料）。首先說明製造方法上之三個主要部分：擴散（diffusion）、平版照相術（lithography）及薄膜沉積（thin-film deposition）然後再介紹這些方法如何應用在各種元件所需之物理特性及元件設計有關之訊息後者則需要了解各種製造策略之目的及限制時再隨時給予介紹。1 .半導體物理特性基本概念，2. 半導體製程初論，3 .薄膜製程原理，4 .擴散原理，5 .黃光製 程原理，6 .蝕刻製程原理，7 .晶片封裝，8 積體電路製程整合。本課程之目的在於介紹一些廣泛、基本及實際的微電子材料（其中最主要者為積體電路之材料）。首先說明製造方法上之三個主要部分：擴散（diffusion）、平版照相術（lithography）及薄膜沉積（thin-film deposition）然後再介紹這些方法如何應用在各種元件所需之物理特性及元件設計有關之訊息後者則需要了解各種製造策略之目的及限制時再隨時給予介紹。1 .半導體物理特性基本概念，2. 半導體製程初論，3 .薄膜製程原理，4 .擴散原理，5 .黃光製 程原理，6 .蝕刻製程原理，7 .晶片封裝，8 積體電路製程整合。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Semiconductor Materials.

description.zh: 相圖及相變化熱力學, 多元溶液及部份莫耳熱力學。以熱力學分析. 設計及電腦模擬冶金方法。
description.en: The thermodynamics of phase diagrams and phase transformations. Solution thermodynamics of multi-compoment and partial molar properties. Applications of thermodynamics to the analysis, design and computer simulation of metallurgical processes.

description.zh: 1. 合金製程簡介 2. 成份改變製程 a. 合金熔煉 - 感應電爐、真空感應電爐 b. 合金精煉 - 電弧爐、c. 電渣重熔精煉、真空電弧精煉、電子束精煉、電漿精煉 3. 合金結構改變製程 a. 凝固控製與快速凝固 b. 方向性凝固 c. 熱處理控制 - 均質化、強化處理 d. 鍛造、晶粒控制 4. 合金形狀改重製程鍛造、軋壓、擠形、粉末冶金 5. 未來合金製程之發展及電腦之應用
description.en: This course is a special topics of Processes of Structural Alloys.

description.zh: 建築物勘測、負載計算實例實做、風管製圖、水管路系統製圖、冷凍空調配電設計實例實做、設備安裝－位置選定、基礎、避震及噪音控制、工程估價實例。
description.en: Building's survey, case study- load calculation, air duct system schematic drawing, water piping system schematic drawing. HVAC & R electric power system design & drawing, equipment installations-layout, foundation, vibration & noisy control planning. Engineering cost estimation practices & analysis.

description.zh: 本課程主要針對半導體與光電廠務設施作一般性的論述，課程包含廠務設施的九大系統：冰水機系統、排氣系統、電力監控系統、壓縮空氣系統、氮氣系統、純水系統、真空系統、製程冷卻水系統及外氣空調系統。期使修習本課程之學生有一和實務聯結之機會，並和理論作相相互映證。
description.en: This course aims to provide students a broad scope of hand-on knowledge on the facility system of a semiconductor or photonic fabrication factory. The facility system includes nine sub-systems: chilled water system, exhaust air system, compressed air system, process cooling water (PCW) system, vacuum system, ultra pure water (UPW) system, power and monitoring system, nitrogen system and fresh air system. Course material is basically based on and closely linked with field operational experience. A factory visit tour will be arranged.

name.zh: 半導體與光電廠務設施
name.en: The facility system of semiconductor or photonic fabrication

description.zh: 課程內容包含：系統定義、資料分析、迴歸方法、系統元件數值模建立、數值計算方法、系統性能模擬及數值佳化方法。
description.en: The course materials are as follows: definition of system, analysis of data, regression method, modeling equipment, numerical calculation, simulation and optimization of system

description.zh: 本課程為研究所熱流科學基礎課程之一，內容主要包括質量、動量與能量守恆方程式的推導，以及它們的解析與近似解，應用範圍包含非旋轉流、低雷諾數流以及高雷諾數 (邊界層) 流等等。
description.en: This course is one of the fundamental courses in the thermofluid sciences for graduate students. Based upon the concept of conservation, the equations of mass, momentum, and energy will be derived. This course will deal with solutions of these equations, both exact and approximate. The application of solutions includes irrotational flow, low Reynolds number flow, and high Reynolds number (boundary layer) flow, etc.

description.zh: 本課程主要是教導學生在熱流學領域上的基本知識，課程內容主要包括: 1. 熱力特性簡介， 2. 熱力學基本定律， 3. 基本冷凍空調循環， 4. 流體特性簡介， 5. 柏努利方程式， 6. 管內與管外流， 7. 穩態與暫態熱傳分析， 8. 散熱片之熱傳分析， 9. 強制對流分析， 10. 自然對流分析， 11. 具相變化的熱對流: 凝結與沸騰。
description.en: This course is to teach students the basic knowledge of thermo-fluid sciences. The main content includes: 1. Introduction to thermodynamic properties, 2. Basic laws of thermodynamics, 3. Fundamentals of Refrigerating and air-conditioning cycles, 4. Introduction of fluid properties, 5. Bernoulli equation, 6. Internal and external flows, 7. Steady and transient heat conduction analysis, 8. Heat transfer from extended surfaces, 9. Forced convection, 10. Natural convection, 11. Heat transfer with phase change: boiling and condensation.

description.zh: 全球環境及永續發展問題的解決，必須從宏觀的視野分析及規劃，並擬定能適合符合當地的策略及做法，方能竟其功。本課程著重在從系統的角度，辨別及解決環境問題。分別從傳統環境系統分析與環境系統動態模擬的方法，模擬環境的問題。學生將會學到了解何謂系統思考、環境系統運作的基本原理、環境系統化管理的工具，以及環境系統動態模擬軟體 Stella，並學習如何實際模擬各種環境問題。
description.en: Global environmental problems and sustainable development issues must be solved from a systems perspective to avoid shifting problems from one place to another. This course uses systems thinking to explore the relationship among various factors which affecting environment and sustainable development. Modeling techniques, such as system dynamic modeling (i.e. Stalla) and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be used for simulating the actual environmental and sustainable problems. Students will learn the interrelation between the environment and the Earth and understand both theory and practices of solving environmental and sustainable problems.

name.zh: 環境暨永續系統化管理

description.zh: 能源在日常生活中以很多型態呈現，大量的能源使用於汽車動力、食物與用水加熱、產品製造、發電及其他不同事務。使用傳統能源會排放空氣污染物，因而引起鄰近地區、區域、跨國境空氣污染問題，甚至是全球的環境衝擊效應。本課程將檢視能源使用現況及其衍生的環境議題，並且探討能源使用之趨勢。傳統能源 (如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等)、及再生能源 (如太陽能、水力、風能、地熱能等) 及能源效率等內容，都將於課程中介紹
description.en: Energy enters our everyday lives in many ways. Prodigious amounts of energy are used to power automobiles, heat food and water, manufacture products, generate electricity, and perform various other tasks. The use of traditional energy will emit air pollutants that may result in regional air pollution problem as well as global effects. In this course we will look at the current energy situation, its environmental implications, and try to determine the patterns of energy use. We will look at energy use as coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear energy, and renewable energy, such as solar energy, hydroelectric

interdisciplinary:
生態工法與土木環境學程
永續環境設計學程

description.zh: 本課程主要以公平交易法與營業秘密法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；深入分析公平交易法與營業秘密法之內涵，進而個別探討公平交易法與營業秘密法等之智財權利行使的課題。
description.en: This course majors in the purpose, evolution, and development trend of legislation on the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, with an attempt to differentiate between the two Acts in respect of objects, approaches, and choice of law that the Acts apply to. In this course, analyses are also made, in depth, on the essence of the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, together with discussion, respectively, on implementation of Intellectual Property Rights involved in the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act.

name.zh: 營業秘密法與公平交易法專題研究
name.en: Seminar on Monographic Study on Trade Secret Act and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 1. 建築管理行政體系及法源介紹。2. 建築管理之對象人、事、物介紹。3. 建築許可之申請、審核、核發、列管及追蹤作業。4. 建築物之施工管理及工程糾紛處理。5. 建築物使用與變更使用之管理。6. 建築物昇降設備管理制度介紹。7. 建築物違章之查報與拆除。8. 建築物公共安全檢查法律依據及作業程序。9. 建築管理的發展方向。10. 建築師及營造業管理之基本概念及未來之工作方向。
description.en: 1. Introducing the hierarchical of building department and government administration rules of the building.2. Introducing administrative terms of building with owner, designer or supervisor of building, construction work, building site, and building itself.3. Application procedure for a building permit, include application, judgement, approbation, management and audit.4. Administration for Building construction and construction dispute intermediation.5. Administration for building occupancy and alterations.6. Introducing administration of building elevator facilities.7. Illegal building administration and dismantling.8. Inspection procedure for building safety and procedure rules.9. The development direction of building administration.10. The basic concept and executive direction in the future for administration of Architect and construction.

description.zh: 本課程主要探討物業管理理論以及實際的操作手法。並結合現有的物業管理案例說明其實例運作方式在台灣的課題與機會。
description.en: The scope of this curriculum encompasses the theories of the propertymanagement, including:1. Introduction(The definition of Reuse, Reduce and Recycle).2. Main methodologies and evaluating tools of building-reuse.3. Case study: Mass housing renewal in European countries & Japan.4.Renewal operation of infill-based building components: Case study on Partitions, kitchens& Sanitary spaces.5. Relation between Building renewal and urban tissue.

description.zh: 景觀生態學是以生態學理論來理解並建立一套可以認知景觀與其中的生物﹑非生物環境關係的學科。有關景觀的生態規劃理論基本上是將這一系列景觀生態學模型或原理作為設計指標而形成的一套規劃操作理論。景觀生態原理在景觀學科中具有極其根本的角色，不僅在景觀資源保育與管理上提供極具價值的參考；對於景觀規畫與設計實務者更提供了在不同尺度範疇狀況下三向度空間設計的形態準則。因此，課程涵蓋了從區域、基地和細部設計三種尺度的設計內涵，講述及操作在基於不同目的的需求時，人為景觀如何介入自然環境，以及導入的人為景觀的設計準則。 1. 景觀生態與形態理論 2. 景觀生態設計理論 3. 景觀生態規劃理論的應用 a. 都市地區和鄉村地區 b. 區域、基地和細部設計尺度
description.en: Landscape ecology seeks for principles and models that contribute to dealing with conservation, management, and planning in landscape practice. The course "Landscape Theory and Practice of Ecological Planning" refers to those principles and models established in landscape ecology and then applies to landscape planning and design. Issues relates to this courses are listed as follows; 1. Landscape Ecology and landscape morphology 2. Ecological planning theory 3. The application of ecological theory in landscape practice a. Urban region and countryside b. Macro-sale, meso-sale, and micro-scale

name.en: Theory and Practice of Landscape Ecological Planning

interdisciplinary:
生態工法與土木環境學程
永續環境設計學程

description.zh: 本課程以地域論述為中心講述有關知識體系的基礎和架構。第一部份涵蓋人文主義地理學、文化地景、以及存在主義及其支系的現象學等基礎；第二部份講授以上述知識論為主的地景和建築詮釋與實踐，包括城市規劃、建築和地景建築理論等範疇的相應，介紹地域論者如 Lewis Mumford, Liane Lefaivre, Alexander Tzonis, Kenneth Frampton 等人的觀點。第三部分為以台灣地區地域地景與建築思維的議題導向，進一步充實地域文化的空間 - 形式的智性思維。
description.en: This course is underpinned upon the epistemology of Regionalism that consisted of three parts. The first part traces back to Humanistic Geography, Cultural Landscape, Existentialism and its philosophical branch line-phenomenology, which are sources of the Regionalism. The second part is centered on interpretation and implementation in either landscape or architecture disciplines, in relation to the perspectives of city planning, architecture, and landscape architecture. And Regionalist advocates like Lewis Mumford, Liane Lefaivre, Alexander Tzonis, Kenneth Frampton and so on are included. The third part involves the regional issues by local-oriented issues of Taiwan. A few of cultural Space-From topics are introduced to substantiate intellectual understandings.

name.en: Regional Methodology on Landscape and Architecture

description.zh: 本課程為台灣傳統建築文化系列課程之一，其主旨在介紹台灣傳統建築的理論與原則，藉由已有的研究案例與成果，使同學能擴展其對台灣傳統建築研究的視界，並就傳統建築中特定建築類型與空間文化議題進行研討，除了經由地方志等文獻的解讀，以了解建築所屬的特殊空間文化意涵外，並由同學進行特定建築的實地調查，以供印證。本課程期使修課同學除了對傳統建築的意義有所瞭解外，亦對特定建築類型的社會文化意義有所體認。
description.en: This course is one of the series of Taiwan traditional architectural culture courses. Its main purpose is to introduce the theories and principles of Taiwanese traditional architecture. With the help of existing research cases and achievements, students can expand their horizons in the study of Taiwanese traditional architecture and learn from traditional architecture. Discussions on specific architectural types and spatial culture issues in architecture, in addition to reading local chronicles and other documents to understand the special spatial cultural meaning of the building, and students conduct field investigations on specific buildings for verification. This course enables students to not only understand the significance of traditional architecture, but also understand the social and cultural significance of specific architectural types.

name.en: Traditional architecture of Taiwan in Special Topics

description.zh: 藉由本課程讓學生了解下列智慧建築之相關事項：1、智慧建築之發展及構成。2、自動化科技對建築物之影響與效益。3、資訊通信系統與網路技術在建築及工程上之運用。4、台灣地區智慧建築在實施過程中所面臨之問題與應注意之事項。5、智慧建築之系統整合與綜合佈線。6、智慧型建築之設施管理。7、智慧建築標章之評估指標。8、智慧建築之規劃設計與案例說明。
description.en: To provide students with the knowledge about intelligent buildings, the following topics are taught in this course:1.The development and composition of intelligent building2.Influence of automation technology on buildings3.Application of information communication system and internet technology on buildings4.Problems faced during the course of implementing intelligent building in Taiwan5.System integration and wiring for intelligent building6.Facilities management of intelligent building7. Evaluation Index of intelligent building8.Planning, design, and case studies of intelligent building

description.zh: 台灣推動長照 2.0，目前已經有多所日照中心於短期內設置，為了達到在地老化，故建立以使用者為中心的服務體系、發展以社區為基礎的整合型服務。本課程將以跨領域觀點探討高齡友善都市及社區的相關理念與實務。
description.en: To promote Long-term care 2.0 in Taiwan, currently it has a considerable amount of adult day-care being set up in a short-term. In order to achieve aging in place, we plan to establish the user-centric service system, and develop the community-based integrated service. This course will use cross-disciplinary viewpoint to survey the concept and practice for Aging-Friendly cities and communities.

name.en: Special Topics on Long-Term Care and Environment (I)

notes: 建都所日職與設計博合開

description.zh: 本課程深入探討吸附與離子交換的基本原理及相關理論分析，進而了解如何設計改進相關之分離技術。內容包括吸附原理、吸附之數學模式、吸附分離技術之應用、離子交換原理、離子交換之數學模式、離子交換分離技術之應用。
description.en: This course will cover the analysis of principle and theory of adsorption and ion exchange. This course contains principle, mathematical model and application of adsorption and ion exchange in separation technology.

description.zh: 邀請校內外學者專家至校針對某一專長領域進行專題演講，讓學生藉由聽講及心得報告之寫作，開展視野，並與時代之脈動相契合。(在職專班)
description.en: Invited speakers from different disciplines give speech in their specialized area. Thus students can broaden their eyesight and also keep updating the technology and its applications of the generation.

description.zh: 瞭解並熟悉有染顏料化學與染顏料材料基礎知識及專業資訊, 並使應用於染顏料化學基礎能力之研習，並掌握實驗分析及染顏料基礎材料配方之操作實務。
description.en: Students can understand and be familiar with the professional information of pigment dye and pigment materials chemistry basics.By learning the professional information and skill of pigment dye chemical, student can possess practical experience of dye pigment formulations and basic materials.

name.zh: 染顏料化學與材料學基礎

description.zh: 「Aromatherapy / 芳香療法」是指藉由芳香植物所萃取出的精油，經由呼吸或皮膚吸收進入體內，達到預防身心靈疾 病與保健的功效，因此「芳香療法」亦可說是一種預防醫學。「芳香療法」在歐洲歷史悠久，而近幾年，台灣人為擁有更健康、 更美好的生活品質以及回歸自然風的養生觀念下，對於「芳香療法 - 植物所提供的自然能量」，逐漸重視與喜愛，並實際應用在 日常生活中，以提昇整體素質。
description.en: Aromatherapy uses plant materials and aromatic plant oils, including essential oils, and other aromatic compounds for the purpose of altering one's mood, cognitive, psychological or physical wellbeing. It can be offered as a complementary therapy or, more controversially, as form of alternative medicine. Complementary therapy can be offered alongside standard treatment, with alternative medicine offered 'instead of conventional treatments', conventional treatments being often scientifically proven.

description.zh: 本課程的目標在使學生了解工業安全衛生的重要, 熟悉有關知識及緊急措施, 從而增加處變之因應能力. 內容包括工業安全衛生組織, 事故調查分析, 工廠設備安全要領, 工業衛生和衛生設備.
description.en: This course is design to introduce the student to concept of the importance of industrial safety and health with emphasis on the ability of dealing with accidents. Topics covered are organization of industrial safety , analysis of Accident ,industrial health and facilities.

description.zh: 擴增實境 (Augmented Reality, AR) 著重在與真實世界的結合，增強真實世界裡的資訊顯示與互動經驗，透過該產品，能夠輕而易舉地得到真實景物的資訊。本課程內容先介紹 AR 原理、技術發展與限制、可應用的展示平台、與其他技術搭配應用、各領域應用案例，如數位學習、醫療、即時翻譯、展示、遊戲與娛樂。
description.en: Augmented Reality (AR) concerns about the combination between real and virtual world. AR technology is to display information inside any objects or devices. The course will introduce AR principles, technology development and constraints, applicable display platform, combination with other technology, implication cases in any fields such as digital learning, medical care, instant translation, display, game and amusement.

description.zh: 本課程將透過介紹及研讀創新服務的標竿案例，以了解創新服務的本質與實質效益。學生將透過共同研討與分組實作的的方式，針對不同場域及技術的創新服務，透過資源整合的方式，提出具體的創新服務專案，並提出其評估的方法。
description.en: This course will provide the student basics knowledge and practical benefits of the innovative services through benchmark case introduction and study. Students will collaborate to each other to propose practical innovation service project proposal in the aspect of resources management, technology applications, service mechanism and associated assessment methods in various domains.

description.zh: 本課程讓學生了解各類口譯實務。學生認識專業口譯員具備之技術與語言能力。實務訓練強化進階口譯技巧，包括積極聆聽、記憶、快速反應、摘要與口譯筆記等。視譯與逐步口譯之訓練以一般性與技術性題材為主，涵蓋政治、財經與全球時事等。
description.en: The course aims to provide students with a practical insight into different modes of interpreting. Practical exercises aimed at developing active listening, memory, quick reflexes, gist extraction and note-taking skills at a more advanced level will be introduced. The training of sight translation and consecutive interpreting involves the use of general and technical speeches in politics, business, world affairs and other fields.

description.zh: 研究生須要具有整合、分析資料與創新思維、寫作能力以完成碩博士論文。本課程主要包括：一、 良好研究特質，二、 研究規劃， 三、學習方法， 四、 創新思維方法 五、 寫作方法， 六、 簡報方法， 七、 研究實務練習
description.en: Graduate students need to integrate information and innovative insights to successfully achieve a master or Ph.D degree. The course includes:1. Characteristics of good researchers.2. Research planning.3. Learning method.4. Innovative thinking.5. Writing method.6. Present method.7. Research design practice

description.zh: 這們課程主要是討論人工智慧 (AI) 的理論基礎與相關應用，課程內容包含：1. AI 問題的解題方法（搜尋技巧）2. 知識表示的方法 3. AI 程式語言：LISP 與 PROLOG4. 推論方法 5. 進階研究主題
description.en: This course provides a thorough discussion of AI's theoretical foundations and advanced applications. These are the following :1. the fundamentals of problem solving (search algorithm)2. knowledge representation3. AI algorithms and data structure in LISP and PROLOG4. algorithms for reasoning5. advanced topics for AI problem solving

description.en: Teaching students to do the research work and to write the papers. Before graduation, the students have possessed the ability to do the R/D work. Each student must be through professor's instrution's instructions to select the topics of special project, personal or group work should be completed the project's hardware or software and issued the paper. An announcement has been made by the department, then get the grade and credit.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用學期至電機相關機構實習（實習實際天數依「校外實習」實行辦法另訂之），參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: The course is developed to increase students' capability of on-job practice. Participation is carried out in one of the corporative electrical engineering company during curriculum session. The students practice and learn the real operation of the electrical engineering related fields. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement.
