電資_第二專長【電子系_積體電路與系統設計】

description.zh: 本課程從社會、藝術、環境、哲學思想與文化等角度剖析二十世紀後地景建築所呈現的各種面向。課程含蓋：一、當代地景建築的前身、萌芽與趨勢。二、當代主要思潮與地景建築的詮釋。三、當代地景建築師和作品之批評與研討。
description.en: This course pinpoints on various aspects of landscape architecture from the 20th century onwards. Social, artistic, environmental, philosophical, and cultural viewpoints involved along the flow of contemporary landscape architecture are to be included. Contents consists of: 1 The germs, predecessors and trends of contemporary landscape architecture. 2 Contemporary interpret on landscape architecture. 3 Critics and Seminars on landscape architects and works of contemporary significance.

description.zh: 了解各種珠寶種類材質、製作技術、製造流程及設備並應用設計的基礎能力，發揮珠寶首飾的設計創意、造形表達；學習珠寶首飾描繪表現技法及基礎製圖法。
description.en: The course is concerned with the design and production of jewellery , siversmithing and related products and is delivered through a programme of lectures and practical design projects in terms of types of materials,techniques of production , and its processes and equipments. Based on the foundation of design skills, the students can practice the techniques of presentation and drawing, and learn how to create new designs of jewellery and its related products.

description.zh: 先修課程：3002014 或負責教授同意。一維及多維穩定態熱傳導及非穩定態熱傳導、對流原理、強迫對流及自然對流經驗和實驗關係式、輻射熱傳遞、凝結與沸騰、熱交換器、熱傳遞中的特殊論題。
description.en: Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction-Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.

interdisciplinary:
核能科技學程
LED照明學程

description.zh: 工程分析概論，有限元素模型建立，進階模組技巧，實體模型的建立，一維元素分析，二維元素分析，三維元素分析，進階範例。
description.en: Introduction to Engineering Analysis, Finite Element Model Constructing, Advanced Techniques of Module, Solid models Constructing, One-dimensional Analysis, Two-dimensional Analysis, Three-dimensional Analysis, Advanced Examples.

description.zh: 本課程為財務會計領域之進階課程，針對已具初級會計學之學生深入講授財務會計之理論、觀念、方法及程序。本課程全面納入國際財務報導準則 (IFRS)，內容包括：介紹財務報導觀念架構、主要財務報表編製、講解資產負債表中有關資產、負債、股東權益以及現金流量表與租賃會計等，修習本課程可使學生對 IFRS 有全面整體了解及運用之能力。亦有助於將來參加會計乙級、記帳士及公務人員高考等證照考試。
description.en: This course is an advanced course for financial accounting. It is to teach the financial accounting theory, concept, method and procedure for students with some basic accounting knowledge. The course covers all the materials to understand financial accounting based on IFRS. The course will help students for preparing advanced license examinations for accounting.

notes: 資財一乙與資財一甲合開

description.zh: 本課旨在研討網路與資訊安全概念與技術，內容包括：網路與資訊安全簡介、資訊中心管理與實體安全、使用者身份識別、作業系統安全、秘密、公開金鑰密碼系統、文件訊息驗證、網路通訊協定 (TCP / IP) 安全、電子商務安全、資料庫安全及系統安全等。
description.en: This course provides an introduction and practical survey of network and information security. This course including network and information security basic introduce, information management and entity security, identification mechanism, public-key encryption, digital signatures and authentication protocols, internet protocol (TCP / IP) security, e-commerce security database security, and system security.

name.en: Introduction to network and information security

description.zh: 石油地質組著重於石油探勘中長期的效益，以提高探勘成功率為宗旨，作先導性之研究，支援現場單位解決地層對比、岩相組織、有效孔隙的問題。盆地分析、石油系統的研究、加強礦區經濟分析，提供探勘策略，促使降低探勘風險。
description.en: Principles of origin, migration, and accumulation of oil and gas. The laboratory introduces the procedures used for exploration, and development of hydrocarbon resources.

description.zh: 體適能為身體適應生活、運動與工作的綜合能力。良好的體適能通常需要經由均衡營養攝取、適當運動以及足夠的睡眠與休息，才能夠獲得。本課程首先聚焦在基本體能訓練，之後，再提供學生選擇有興趣的運動選擇。
description.en: Physical fitness?is the ability to perform aspects of?sports, occupations and daily activities. Physical fitness is generally achieved through proper?nutrition,?appropriate exercise, ?and sufficient rest. This course first focus on basic physical strength training. Then, we provide students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.

description.zh: 本課主旨在培養學生職場英語文溝通能力，如提案、企劃案提寫、時事討論、公司產品行銷、書信寫作，希冀能夠藉由本課程之修習，加強學生進入職場前的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a firm foundation in business communication skills. Students will learn how to present a proposal, start a discussion, and promote company products in English. It is hoped that by the end of this course, students are equipped with sufficient knowledge of general and business English.

notes: 本課程為未通過英文畢業門檻之補救課程

description.zh: 先修課程：3001052 或負責教授同意。介紹 2D / 3D CAD 概論、實體模型系統、特徵式設計系統、曲面模型系統、CAD 或 CAE 系統示範與實作。
description.en: Introduction of CAD software packages, Review of Numerical techniques for CAD.2-D Graphics, 3-D Graphics, and surface modeling, solid modeling. Design optimization, Integrated CAD systems and Animation project.

description.zh: (1) 車床實習：車刀研磨、手動進給手輪切削、自動進刀切削、牙刀研磨，螺紋切削、牙深計算與量測。(2) 銑床實習：虎鉗校正、V 形枕角度計算、斜度計算。面銑刀安裝與實習、端銑刀安裝與實習、斜度銑削。
description.en: Turning machine practices: turning cutting tool grinding, manual feed-wheel cutting, auto feed cutting, screw cutting tool grinding, screw cutting, screw-depth evaluation and measurement.Milling machine practices: vice adjustment, V-block angle measurement, inclination evaluation, face milling tool install and practice, end milling tool install and practice, inclination practice.

description.zh: 先修課程：3001051 或負責教授同意。本課程係以商用繪圖 CAD 軟體（如 TCAD 或 ACAD 等）為教學範本、內容包括二維製圖、三維製圖、修訂功能表、命令腳本（Script）以及圖組 (Block)、圖形功能表等之製作，以輔助機械製圖為主要目標。
description.en: Use commercial CAD softwares (e.g.: Turbo CAD or Auto CAD) as the tutorial examples for Mechanical Drawings, including 2-D and 3-D drawings, to edit and modify the Menu, Script and Block etc..

description.zh: 車廠佈置, 服務管理, 經營管理, 人事管理。
description.en: Workshop layout, service management, business management, personnel management.

name.en: Administration and management of car manufacturer

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹微處理系統的介面設計。其中包括記憶體介面，一般的輸出輸入介面以及 CPLD/FPGA 介面。由於 CPLD 與 FPGA 大量應用在嵌入式系統中，如何利用微處理器的彈性軟體設計，搭配 CPLD/FPGA 的高速運算能力，將是本課程的重點。
description.en: Interfacing between microprocessor and peripheral will be discussed in this course. The interfacing technique includes memory interface, general peripheral and CPLD/FPGA devices. A large number of industrial applications have applied CPLD/FPGA into their design. This course will also focus on integrating of microcontroller and CPLD/FPGA devices by taking advantages of the flexibility of microcontroller and high speed calculation capability of CPLD/FPGA devices.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用整學期至電子工程相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告。須在同一機構連續實習 4.5 月，學生應全職於實習機構實習。
description.en: The course is developed to increase on-job practice capability of students. Participants practice and learn the real operation of the electronic engineering related fields in one of the corporative electronic engineering company during one semester. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement. It is necessary to practice in one corporative electronic engineering company full-time at least 4.5 months.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用課餘至相關機構實習（實習實際天數依「校外實習」實行辦法另訂之），參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業企業之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: The course is developed to increase students' capability of on-job practice. Participation in one of the corporative company during summer vocation, practice and learn the real operation of the ing related fields . A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement.

notes: 選本課程須由系所送出修課名單

description.zh: 經濟分析應用於在需求、成本、生產、利潤和競爭的理論基礎上制定的企業決策。也包括了與特別關聯的管理者的宏觀經濟專題。先修課程：ECON5311（經濟分析）或同等理論。
description.en: Application of economic analysis in formulating business decisions based on the theoretical foundations of demand, cost, production, profits, and competition. Macroeconomic topics of particular relevance to managers are included. Prerequisite: ECON 5311 (ECONOMIC ANALYSIS) or equivalent.

notes: 105 學年度入學授課教師 Mahmut Yasar

description.zh: 對複雜組織中的行為問題的系統研究。分析環境與內部因素的及其對組織行為相互作用及其影響。課程安排在組織過程的上下文中。先修課程：MANA5312 (管理學)。
description.en: Systematic study of behavioral problems in the complex organization. Analyzes the interaction of environmental and internal factors and their effects upon organizational behavior. The course is placed within the context of the organization process. Prerequisite: MANA 5312 (MANAGEMENT).

notes: 106 學年度入學授課教師 Jim Lavelle

description.zh: 商業關注的財務問題的分析，在案例素材中展現出來。考慮資本需求的決定，替代資本投資之間的選擇，融資資本支出的規劃方法；規劃資本重組、兼併和改組。先修課程：FINA5340 (財務管理)
description.en: Analysis of financial problems of business concerns, presented in case materials. Considers determination of capital needs, choosing among alternative capital investments, planning methods of financing new capital expenditures, and planning recapitalizations, mergers, and reorganizations. Prerequisite: FINA 5311 (BUSINESS FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT).

description.zh: 強調現代人力資源管理理論與實踐的戰略視角。主題包括人力資源規劃，人員編制，培訓和發展，薪酬，績效評估和勞資關係。
description.en: Emphasizes strategic perspective of modern human resource management theory and practice. Topics include human resource planning, staffing, training and development, compensation, performance appraisal, and labor and employee relations.

notes: 106 學年度入學授課老師 Benson George S

description.zh: 本課程討論了大資料的概念和原理以及如何在企業中使用大資料。本課程提供了一個大資料分析的基本原則的概述，以及大資料分析在機構作出更好的決策和預測的作用。該課程還涵蓋了技術、基礎設施和大資料應用，以及資料識別、資料清洗和資料集成的概念。還提出了大資料的軟體和應用需求，還對大資料應用的案例研究進行了討論。先修課程：INSY5337 資料庫和商業智能、INSY5325 高級統計方法。
description.en: This course addresses the concepts and principles of Big Data and how Big Data can be used in the Enterprise. The course provides an overview of the fundamental principles of Big Data Analytics and its role in making better decisions and predictions in the organization. The course also covers the Technology, Infrastructure and Applications of Big Data. Concepts of data identification, data cleansing and integration are also addressed. Software and Application requirements of Big Data are addressed and case studies of Big Data Applications are discussed. Prerequisite: INSY 5337 (DATA WAREHOUSING AND BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE) and BSTAT 5325 (ADVANCED STATISTICAL METHODS).

notes: 105 學年度入學授課老師 Sridhar Nerur
